entities.name: Ubiquitin hydrolase B
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt O96612 from Dictyostelium discoideum; 451 aa, 100% identity and coverage.
Contains a USP/UCH ubiquitin-specific protease domain across approximately residues 19–450.
Curated catalytic annotation: cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity, EC 3.4.19.12.
Reference catalytic residues are a nucleophile cysteine at position 399 and proton acceptor at position 408.
Biological role in the matched reference: stabilizes mkkA by preventing ubiquitin-dependent degradation.

entities.name: Ubiquitin C-terminal isopeptide hydrolysis
observations: Thiolate-dependent hydrolysis of peptide or isopeptide bonds formed by the C-terminal glycine of ubiquitin, releasing ubiquitin from a modified substrate or processing ubiquitin precursors; EC 3.4.19.12.
The enzyme uses a catalytic cysteine nucleophile and a proton-accepting residue in the USP catalytic domain.

entities.name: Ubiquitin-specific protease domain
observations: Pfam UCH domain PF00443 detected at residues 19–447 with i-Evalue 6.7e-48.
The domain architecture is consistent with a ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase/deubiquitinase.
